meeting_flow.opening_phrase: Well, thanks for coming on. I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit more about sort of your current situation, an interest in short let, and then we can go through some income figures.
rapport_topics: resolving an audio/earphones issue at the start of the call
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Well, thanks for coming on. I thought I'd start just by understanding a bit more about sort of your current situation.
meeting_flow.income_intro: So I'll just share my screen... This is coming from some comparable properties that we've pulled nearby, and then we've pulled an average together. So we're looking at about 50,000 of gross and about 26,000 of net, which is about 2200 pound per month.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: As far as operationally, we'll deal with everything end to end. As far as managing... We'll set you up on multiple platforms, deal with any sort of dynamic pricing, do our ID checks and security deposits for every guest.
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: What I'll do as well, Thomas, might help a bit is I'll send you a bit like an action plan slash summary after this on an email, with our agreement as well, so you can send that to him.
meeting_flow.close_phrase: I'll send everything over to you next sort of 20 minutes. I'll put our agreement in there as well so you can read some of the terms. We could probably touch base maybe next month or something has changed.
meeting_flow.meeting_2_ask: We could probably touch base maybe next month or something has changed.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Would the worst month be straight to our pocket, or is there deduction for your service?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Explained the worst-month figure is already net of all charges (platform commission, management fee, cleaning/laundry) — it is the payout figure.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Moved straight on to asking about key access while abroad.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How would the person have access to the property considering we won't have anyone there day to day?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Explained key safe (rotating codes) or Keynest (24-hour local key storage with per-stay codes) as the two access methods, then broadened into the full end-to-end management pitch.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Asked whether he could block dates in advance for his own use.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: How would that be covered — will that be us in charge to fix it, or them, or the company that is renting our flat?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Split the answer into two parts: guest-liable damage recovered from the £200-£400 security deposit (backed by ID checks and host-history checks), wear-and-tear or major damage covered by insurance, with a £300/month owner-approval threshold before further works proceed.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Confirmed understanding ('Okay. Okay.') and moved to the mortgage question.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Would having you renting our flat affect our residential mortgage in any way?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Recommended launching as-is for 3-6 months rather than switching to a buy-to-let/holiday-let mortgage immediately, to avoid unnecessary admin if short-let isn't for them, while noting the switch would later roughly halve their mortgage cost.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: 'Nice to you.' — positive, no further pushback.

zac_language.numbers_framing: Leads with the average expected figures first (gross ~£50k, net ~£26k, ~£2,200/month), then shows the seasonal range (worst ~£1,300 to best ~£3,000) against the lead's current ~£1,400 overheads to frame the downside as near break-even rather than a loss, then supports it with market-competitiveness data (61 reviews, 4.7 rating) to set expectations on a ~7-month ramp-up to top-of-market rates.
zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Acknowledges the concern directly, then splits it into a clear two-part structural answer (e.g. guest-liable damage vs. wear-and-tear, deposit vs. insurance) before closing with a concrete, low-pressure recommendation (e.g. delay the mortgage switch 3-6 months) that removes friction without pushing urgency.

what_they_focused_on: damage/liability protection for a fully-furnished flat
what_they_needed_most: operational certainty on who is liable and how access/cleaning/maintenance actually works
reassurance that leaving the flat fully furnished is low-risk
clear, low-friction guidance on mortgage timing rather than being pushed into an immediate change
profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For ABROAD leads whose co-owner is absent from the call, proactively propose a short joint follow-up once the co-owner has reviewed the agreement, rather than leaving the next step as a vague 'touch base next month'.
